results.title: South Korea Missile Strategic Command faces urgent task of deterring North Korea’s nuclear threat
results.description: South Korea must expand missile stockpiles, survivable launchers and AI-enabled strike systems to deter North Korea’s growing nuclear and missile arsenal, writes a former ADD director.

results.title: Colombian judge lifts ban on govt strikes against guerrillas
results.description: The suspension followed the deaths of six minors, as rights groups warn children and teens are increasingly recruited by armed groups.
